mapper.select: SELECT type_id AS typeId, target_category AS targetCategory, target_id AS targetId, extend::text AS extendJson FROM public.type_relations WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY type_id, target_category, target_id
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.type_relations (game_id, type_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, target_category, target_id, extend, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{typeId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{targetCategory}, #{targetId}, CAST(#{extendJson} AS jsonb), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, type_id, target_category, target_id) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, extend = EXCLUDED.extend, updated_at = NOW()
